title: Restore legacy route and interaction baseline
rationale: Ported the archived Senshac Astro surface, localized route tree, Tina boundary, UnoCSS styling, Alpine/HTMX behavior, R2/HLS helpers, SEO endpoints, redirects, and accessibility/performance contracts without copying editorial pages or media into senshac-web.

title: Restore Pages runtime from confirmed archived contract
rationale: The archived production wrangler contract confirms the Pages output directory, nodejs_compat flag, media base URL, MEDIA_RAW R2 bucket, and SESSION KV namespace. The placeholder public index override must stay out of the build so Astro localized routes remain authoritative.

name: canonical chrome presets
description: Site chrome is modeled as chrome.header and chrome.footer with mode, atFinal, and scrolling fields; appearance values are limited to the five canonical presets and runtime defaults preserve legacy page headerStyle until editorial content lands.

name: chrome foreground follows appearance
description: Header controls and footer content should derive foreground colors from the canonical chrome appearance state; CMS social icon values must resolve through a fixed UnoCSS icon allowlist.

name: Tina Astro island route wiring
description: The Tina Astro experimental runtime is restored by exporting experimental_createIslandRoute(createIslands()) from src/pages/tina-island/[name].ts; the package helper preserves preview POST/content-type and same-site boundaries while rendering the existing registry in Cloudflare SSR. Keep a source contract test covering route delegation and all page/global islands.

name: Preserve generated Tina admin bundle
description: Keep tinacms generated public/admin assets in the Pages dist package; use explicit Pages redirects for /admin and /es/admin to canonical /admin/. The typecheck wrapper temporarily hides vendor admin assets so Astro diagnostics remain bounded.

name: Tina browser bundle version coherence
description: Keep tinacms and next-tinacms-s3 aligned with the Tina CLI generation toolchain; the stale tinacms 3.9 dependency caused the generated admin bundle to retain Vite's browser externalization stub for util.inspect. The admin routing check scans generated JS for the resulting .custom runtime error.

name: Tina admin asset normalization and Iconify collections
description: Tina's generated SPA emits orphan Vite browser-external Node stubs from the S3 media dependency; remove those generated stubs in the generation boundary before Pages packaging. UnoCSS preset-icons needs explicit @iconify-json/lucide and @iconify-json/simple-icons collections for mask CSS to be emitted; generated HTML CSS checks catch regressions.

title: Legacy parity audit blocks cutover
rationale: The 2026-09-22 read-only comparison found cutover admin and all four root brand icons returning 404, plus preview.invalid canonical and hreflang URLs; promotion requires deployment identity and runtime verification before domain cutover.

name: Live-edit global chrome and fresh island queries
description: Wrap Base layout header and footer fallbacks in TinaIsland markers using locale params, keep the page island as the sole primary form, and avoid process-wide request caching so deployed preview updates can fetch fresh Tina data.

title: Freeze legacy block parity contract
rationale: Compared senshac-web against archived senshac b46b933: all 19 legacy block templates and 27 metadata marker signatures are already present. Added a focused regression test so future schema or renderer changes expose parity loss.

name: Web quality parity gate
description: The legacy quality parity port is committed as deterministic Bun scripts and budgets; the full bun run quality gate passes after Tina generation, while Astro/Tina deprecation and prerender warnings remain visible as build output for follow-up.
